name: langfuse-api-mcp
description: Read your Langfuse traces, observations, scores, prompts and datasets through the Langfuse public API, Cloud or self-hosted.

public_key.title: Langfuse public key
public_key.description: The project's public key (pk-lf-...). Stored in the OS keychain.

secret_key.title: Langfuse secret key
secret_key.description: The project's secret key (sk-lf-...). Stored in the OS keychain.

base_url.title: Langfuse base URL
base_url.description: Your Langfuse host, e.g. https://cloud.langfuse.com, https://us.cloud.langfuse.com or your self-hosted URL. Must be https (http only for localhost).

ca_cert.title: CA certificate (optional)
ca_cert.description: A PEM file with your corporate or private CA, added to the system trust store. Leave empty when your Langfuse host has a public certificate.
